nvitk.gui.core.backend¶

GUI helpers aligned with the global nvitk backend (nvitk.core.backend).

The active backend is set by nvitk-gui --backend cpu|gpu, the dock GPU toggle (nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle), or set_default_backend().

Functions¶

gpu_enabled(→ bool)

True when the global backend is CuPy.

layer_data_for_tool(→ Any)

Coerce layer data for tool input using the global backend.

napari_array(→ numpy.ndarray)

Always return a NumPy array suitable for Napari (no implicit CuPy conversion).

napari_label_array(→ numpy.ndarray)

NumPy array for Napari that keeps its integer dtype, for label-map results.

run_with_backend()

Context manager scoped to the current global backend.

nvitk.gui.core.backend.napari_label_array(out: Any) → numpy.ndarray¶

NumPy array for Napari that keeps its integer dtype, for label-map results.

napari_array() casts to float64, which is right for intensities and wrong for a label map: the ids survive the round trip numerically, but the layer can no longer be added as a Napari Labels layer without a second cast, and every downstream unique comes back as floats. Tools that return a parcellation use this instead.

A non-integer result is left alone rather than rounded — silently quantising a float map into label ids would invent a parcellation that the operation never produced.
